description: This schema lists all the fields, data types, and structures that you can fetch from TMDB and store in your database for movies/TV shows, categories (genres), and tags.

movie_or_tv_details.description: Information about a single Movie or TV Show, including cast, crew, and video links.

id.description: TMDB ID of the content. Use this to prevent duplicates and reference TMDB API.

title.description: The title of the movie (TMDB: 'title') or TV show name (TMDB: 'name').

original_title.description: Original title in the original language.

overview.description: A short summary or plot description.
overview.example: A ticking-time-bomb insomniac and a slippery soap salesman channel primal male aggression into a shocking new form of therapy...

tagline.description: A brief catchphrase or slogan of the movie.

type.description: Specifies whether it is a 'movie' or 'tv' show.

release_date.description: The release date (TMDB: 'release_date' for movie, 'first_air_date' for TV show).

runtime.description: Duration of the movie in minutes (or average episode runtime for TV shows).

vote_average.description: Average rating of the movie (from 1 to 10).

vote_count.description: Total number of users who rated it.

poster_path.description: Relative URL path to the poster image (e.g. /hE2B4HS23n.jpg). Append to Image Base URL.

backdrop_path.description: Relative URL path to the banner image (backdrop).

categories.description: Array of category (genre) IDs associated with the movie.

tags.description: Array of custom tags or keyword IDs.

cast.description: List of main actors from the movie credits.

crew.description: List of key crew members (specifically Directors/Writers).

categories.description: Movie and TV show genres (mapped to 'categories').

id.description: TMDB genre ID (e.g. 28 for Action, 35 for Comedy).

slug.description: URL-friendly slug generated from the name.

tags.description: Custom hashtags or keywords used to filter movies (e.g. Superhero, Netflix Original).

id.description: Unique tag identifier inside your local database.
